### Running Aground
Author: Marybeth Whalen
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-october-6-2011.html
Passage: Acts 27:26
Points:
- Sudden setbacks can throw our lives off course just when we feel certain of our direction.
- Painful delays and detours are often part of God's sovereign plan.
- Running aground does not mean you have drifted outside of God's will.
- Unplanned seasons of waiting provide opportunities to deepen our trust in the Lord.

### Up Against the Wall
Author: Dr. James Dobson
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-devotions-for-parents-by-dr-james-dobson/dr-dobsons-parenting-devotional-june-14.html
Passage: Acts 27:25
Points:
- Life's barriers often appear massive and impenetrable until we confront them directly.
- Paul urged his shipmates to maintain courage because he believed God's word.
- Believers can face seemingly insurmountable circumstances through the Lord's strength.
- Parents should encourage their children to take courage when backed against a wall.

### Day 291: Acts 27:13–26
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-291-acts-27-1326.html
Passage: Acts 27:13-26
Points:
- Stay anchored in Christ during calm seasons rather than developing false self-security.
- Yield to the Master of the seas instead of succumbing to helplessness in the storm.
- Jettison old grievances and abandon reliance on man-made coping mechanisms.
- Refuse to cut loose your hope, trusting God to speak and sustain you through trial.

### Anchor of Stability
Author: Pastor Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/individual/anchor-of-stability
Passage: Acts 27:1-26
Points:
- Fierce circumstances can quickly cause us to lose our bearings and give up hope.
- God meets us at our lowest moments with the assurance that He has a plan.
- Scripture is the true anchor of stability when all human navigation fails.
- God's faithful presence guarantees that encroaching trials will not overwhelm us.
